value.text: The saved process declaration proposes a weather.forecast-updated mapping to Dashboard.consumeMessage; subscription settings and runtime delivery remain unverified. For that topic, validateEvent requires a string id, version 1, an allowed place id (oslo, helsinki, lisbon), string name, finite coordinates, type forecast.updated, valid updatedAt/fetchedAt timestamps, fixture or live mode, and 1–6 periods. Each period needs a valid time, finite temperature, null or finite nonnegative precipitation, and a string symbol. Parse or validation failures, including UNKNOWN_TOPIC, are caught, recorded as INVALID_EVENT, and followed by offset plus one; reject-write or offset-commit errors propagate. On valid input, applyEvent inserts the id into inbox in a transaction. A duplicate commits and returns DUPLICATE without changing the card. A new forecast can insert its card directly from event.place, without a prior place-requested event; an existing card updates only when its stored timestamp is null or older, while equal or older timestamps leave it unchanged and return OLDER_OR_EQUAL. Connected-client transaction errors attempt rollback and release in finally; connection errors occur before the try, and either failure prevents the offset commit. The DB transaction commits before the offset, so a later offset failure can replay the message; inbox suppresses a second card update, not duplicate delivery. Runtime remains unverified.
